worst_moment: "The ideal gas law needs temperature in Kelvin, not degrees Celsius. So 25°C is 298 K. What is 25 + 273?" - gives away 298 K and then asks the student to compute it.
best_moment: "...For example, if a gas is at 100 K and we double the Kelvin temperature to 200 K, the volume doubles..." - a concrete example of why an absolute scale matters.
